evidence.quote: Looking forward, if the economy evolves broadly as expected, policy will move over time toward a more neutral stance. But we are not on any preset course.
Disinflation has been broad based, and recent data indicate further progress toward a sustained return to 2 percent.
Still, labor market conditions have clearly cooled over the past year.
We do not believe that we need to see further cooling in labor market conditions to achieve 2 percent inflation.
Today, we see the risks to achieving our employment and inflation goals as roughly in balance.
